title: Advent wreath with candle cups
text: Advent wreath with candle cups. it's much smaller than I imagined, but as I wanted to carry it back and forth to a religious education class I teach, the small size and the built in candle cups were ideal.  Placed it on our coffee table between classes and 'dressed it up' a bit with pink and purple ribbons.  Worked very well for my class and will reuse it year after year.

product_metadata.title: Darice 12" Two-Tone Pine Artificial Christmas Advent Wreath - Holds 4 Taper Candles
